Description: Trial-by-trial derivative reconstructed from the FCDT BIDS response-level files for Experiment 1 of Brüning et al. (2020). Each row is one response event with the visible stimulus in task stream A and task stream B before that response.
ParadigmNaming: Paradigm names combine the target-detection task (PTD or LTD) and classification task (RMC or DPC).
P: Participant number without BIDS zero padding.
B: Continuous local block within a run, incremented when condition, trial counter, or local response clock resets.

Levels.PTD-RMC: 2D pattern target detection and 3D rotation/mirror classification.
Levels.PTD-DPC: 2D pattern target detection and digit-parity classification.
Levels.LTD-RMC: Letter-pair target detection and 3D rotation/mirror classification.
Levels.LTD-DPC: Letter-pair target detection and digit-parity classification.

T: Inferred target stimulus set for the memory-search task in this block. Inferred from positive target trials (source value true) in the same block. Verbal pairs are canonicalized because order was irrelevant in the task.

O.Description: Trial onset in seconds, relative to the first stimulus onset of the current continuous block. The first trial starts at 0.000; each following trial starts at the previous response time.

sA: Visible stimulus in task stream A immediately before the selected response. Image stimuli are compacted from BIDS-relative rimages/... paths to filename stems and can be resolved against PNG files in the derivative stimuli/images directory. Terminal block states may be n/a when the source data do not contain the final unresponded stimulus for this stream.
sB: Visible stimulus in task stream B immediately before the selected response. Image stimuli are compacted from BIDS-relative rimages/... paths to filename stems and can be resolved against PNG files in the derivative stimuli/images directory. Terminal block states may be n/a when the source data do not contain the final unresponded stimulus for this stream.
a1: First action: participant task choice, coded as the selected task stream A or B.
a2: Second action: participant task response, mapped to 1 for yes/true and 0 for no/false.
a_t: Action tuple (j, k), with task j = 1 or 2 and binary response k = 0 or 1. Stored as tuple text in CSV, e.g. (1, 0).
r: Reward feedback, coded as 1 for correct responses and 0 for incorrect responses.

RT.Description: Post-stimulus response time for the selected task stimulus in seconds, reconstructed as response_ms minus stim_pres_ms.
